fieldissues.issue: The title and long add later emergency orders and projected ratepayer costs, but the only linked source is DOE’s May order for J.H. Campbell. The merged text says the DOE link does not verify the additional orders or costs.
‘Coal Plant Lifeline’ and ‘Dying Plants’ are editorial labels, and ‘Orders’ suggests multiple orders although the title centers on one plant.

proposedchanges.change: Provide source URLs for the additional Indiana, Washington, and Colorado orders and for CNN’s ratepayer-cost estimate. Otherwise narrow the entry to the May 23 order requiring J.H. Campbell to remain available.
Use ‘DOE Orders Michigan Coal Plant to Remain Available After Scheduled Retirement’.

evidencebasis: The packet’s DOE URL supports the May 23 order for J.H. Campbell. The merged long notes that the listed later orders and ratepayer costs lack support from the supplied linked source.
notes: The DOE URL is retained. The source gap prevents a reliable release of the broader claims.

fieldissues.issue: ‘Halts All Funding’ is broader than the description, which says NSF paused new awards and payments on existing grants.
Government Corruption does not describe grant cancellations and a funding pause.
Donald Trump is tagged but not named in the title or descriptions.

proposedchanges.change: Use ‘NSF Cancels More Than 1,000 Research Grants and Pauses Awards and Payments’.
Use a neutral federal research-funding or agency-policy classification if available. Do not imply corruption from the grant cancellations alone.
Remove Donald Trump unless the final description names his role in the decision.

evidencebasis: The packet describes more than 1,000 cancellations and an April 30 pause in new awards and existing payments. The long distinguishes the grants restored by injunction from all other awards. The NYT URL is retained.
notes: The medium and long are distinct and identify the court order as preliminary. The numeric ID identifies an existing entry.

fieldissues.issue: The long refers to ‘the supplied context’ and says ‘this entry therefore does not assign’ a figure. Those phrases describe editorial process rather than the policy and estimates.

proposedchanges.change: Replace the internal commentary with a reader-facing sentence such as: ‘Neither estimate isolates the separate effect of work requirements.’ Remove ‘the supplied context’ and ‘this entry’ language.

evidencebasis: The correction notes distinguish the Medicaid-only 7.5 million estimate from the broader 10 million estimate and state that no separate work-requirement estimate was supplied. Both source URLs are retained.
notes: The title and medium state the 7.5 million Medicaid estimate accurately and distinguish it from the broader health-coverage projection.

fieldissues.issue: ‘Killed’ and ‘Has No Teeth’ are loaded conclusions. The packet says the rescission ended three planned pilots and that analysts questioned how the later order could be enforced.
Government Corruption does not describe changes to prescription-drug policy and Medicare/Medicaid programs.

proposedchanges.change: Use ‘Trump Rescinds Biden Drug-Cost Order and Issues Most-Favored-Nation Pricing Directive’.
Use a neutral health-care or prescription-drug policy classification if available. Do not describe the pricing order as corruption or unenforceable as a settled fact.

evidencebasis: The White House orders and supplied summary document the rescission and the later most-favored-nation directive. The packet attributes enforceability concerns to analysts and legal experts. Both source URLs are retained.
notes: The medium and long distinguish the statutory insulin and out-of-pocket caps from the canceled pilot programs.

The tags are fragments copied from the truncated title rather than topics or named people.
National Security Violations / War / Militarization overstates a warning of possible U.S. action against Colombia.

Describe only the Colombia warning and later meeting. Remove the Cuba reference unless a source documents it.
Use U.S.-Colombia relations, military threat, drug-trafficking accusations, Gustavo Petro, and White House meeting.
Use Foreign Policy with a U.S.-Colombia relations subcategory.

evidencebasis: The packet says the linked AP report supports the Colombia warning and later conciliatory meeting, but not the Cuba reference. The AP URL is retained.
notes: The long attributes the warning and later meeting to AP reporting. The numeric ID identifies an existing entry.
